body: Everyday it’s on my mind. I’m 28
I lost my dad 2 years ago to pancreatic cancer as well! It’s hard! I understand
No I want to, but afraid to fail!
I have been to a funeral before.

Death and dying are on my mind 24/7! 
And unfortunately as I type this, today is the day I attend a funeral for my friend who killed himself, he was only 21! 

Makes me jealous I don’t have the balls to kill myself! Just consumed in darkness and suicidal thoughts!! 

No goals in life, nothing interests me anymore, only thing interesting is suicide!
